description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers DE+EN phrasings for git-history release forensics (hotspot risk, change-coupling, release-review evidence). Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours: security incident forensics (incident-commander), plain git log, runtime performance hotspots (performance-analysis), line blame, security audit.

queries.q: which files are the riskiest hotspots in this release
run the forensics report for the release review
zeig mir hotspot und coupling evidenz für das release
machine-derived evidence for the release review
do a forensic analysis of the security incident from last night
show me the git log for the last week
find the performance hotspots in production at runtime
who wrote this line — run git blame on it
run a security audit on the auth module
